prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one transparent production character sprite for the existing Canran English journey-map homepage, Lesson 5–6. Create a polished wide image, target about 1536 x 1024 pixels, with real transparent alpha.
Input references, in strict order:
1. approved-mobile-v1.png is the sole approved visual master: warm storybook brown outlines, friendly compact characters in a sunlit coral-and-ivory journey world. Match its character feeling, NOT its full interface or environment.
2. handbag-couple.png is the exact already-shipping full-body drawing/style/proportion reference. Match its rounded warm dark-brown line quality, clear face shapes, restrained soft shading, warm light from upper left, simplified hands and brown shoes. Do NOT copy these two identities, clothing, hat, or red handbag.
3. unit5-6-friends.webp establishes ONLY the three required Lesson 5–6 identities, clothing colors and greeting relationship. Reimagine these same three people as complete standing full-body characters in reference 2's style. Do NOT copy its classroom, pale vignette, or cut-off bodies.

Primary subject: exactly THREE friendly compact figures, about 2.2–2.6 heads tall, meeting and introducing themselves, all shown from hair to complete feet. Left to right:
LEFT: Mr Blake, side-parted medium brown hair, distinctive rectangular/square dark-brown glasses, muted sage-green / grey-green suit, ochre-yellow buttoned vest, white shirt and green necktie, charcoal trousers, brown shoes. He holds ONE closed red book against his chest/side and warmly introduces the two friends with his free open palm.
CENTER: Sophie, shoulder-length wavy/curly warm brown hair with a small yellow hair clip, coral-pink dress with rounded white collar, small yellow shoulder bag with its strap clearly visible, brown shoes. She smiles toward Hans, with a gentle greeting gesture or hands near her bag strap.
RIGHT: Hans, tousled curly blond hair, mustard yellow jacket, white shirt, green bow tie, visible brown backpack straps, dark trousers and brown shoes. He smiles toward the group and waves with one raised open hand; the other hand holds one backpack strap.

Composition: natural close three-person introduction, bodies clear and only lightly overlapping; eye contact and gesture relationship readable at a mobile display width of 190–220 px and desktop width of 320–380 px. Compact friendly proportions like the handbag couple, not tall realistic adults. All six feet touch one common baseline. Keep all hair, fingers, elbows, bag and shoes entirely inside the image. Center the trio with about 8–10% truly transparent margin on every side. Preserve separation of the three silhouettes. They will be composited in front of an EXISTING school landmark, so provide only the characters and their carried book/bag/backpack.

Rendering: clean warm dark-brown bold rounded outlines, simple paper-storybook coloring, gentle warm highlights and restrained soft tonal shading, clear warm peach faces with rosy cheeks. Match the first two references' final production quality. No photorealism, no glossy 3D clay, no anime, no harsh black contours.
Mandatory exclusions: NO background of any color; NO checkerboard painted into the image; NO school, classroom, architecture, trees, plants, ground, grass, island, stage, pedestal, oval ground shadow, grounding shadow disc, vignette, halo, border, labels, numbers, words, letters, speech bubble, stars, UI, logos or watermark. No floating decorative marks. Real transparent alpha around and between the figures. Do not generate Lesson 1–2's man or hat-wearing woman. Exactly three people, exactly one red book, one yellow shoulder bag, one worn backpack.
